svg.desc: Hallucination: driftbench 71 of 72, other 36 of 72. Faithfulness: driftbench 71 of 72, other 36 of 72. Turn relevancy: driftbench 65 of 72, other 36 of 72. Completeness: driftbench 70 of 72, other 46 of 72. Role adherence: driftbench 72 of 72, other 63 of 72.
